description: The valid pack SEALED with a key nobody defined inside an artifact entry — a claim a relying party could read as evidence. SPEC §9.1/§6.9 (1.6.0, not additive): a refusal of class unknown_member, as in every other object of §9.1 (1.4.0–1.5.4: an artifact error, so digest_ok, bindings_ok and policy_ok were true and a reader of those fields saw an altered artifact).
